content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text assigns UNDERDETERMINED to D5 vs C5 on Isaiah 7:14 by citing the verse's two aspects, the virgin and young-woman wording and the prophetic application, so it is deciding the link from a single verse's ambiguity.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open.","room":"When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open -- I weighed whether Isaiah 7:14's two aspects both stand rather than remain open, versus the judge treating them as leaving the link UNDERDETERMINED.","why":"K-S2 forbids using the fact that a single verse does not itself settle a link to make it UNDERDETERMINED, and requires both senses of a verse carrying two meanings to stand rather than remain open; the judge does the former by leaving Isaiah 7:14 open after both sides addressed its wording and application."}
